test(site): the site test waits for the branch to reach the page, as it already waits for the seek (brandon-unfiled-3248.frhb)

The first redraw drew before the daemon's branch read landed, so on a loaded
runner the page still showed the pending 'polled' segment. That failed the
main run of the trusted-publishing merge twice and held its Release job back.

fix(release): Publish job uses npm trusted publishing, no stored token (#943)

fix(release): the Publish job publishes by npm trusted publishing, with no stored token (brandon-unfiled-3248.frhb)

NPM_TOKEN was a granular token with npm's 90-day cap; it expired and every
publish since v1.236.6 failed, which npm reports as E404. Each @promptctl
package now names this repo's release.yml as its trusted publisher, so the
job's OIDC identity is the credential. Trusted publishing needs npm 11.5.1+,
which Node 22 does not ship.
